title: Freight Claims: Loss and Damage Deadlines and Carrier Duties
excerpt: What counts as a freight claim, the carrier's 30-day and 120-day response clock under 49 CFR 370, and the 9-month and 2-year minimum periods in 49 U.S.C. 14706.
meta_title: Freight Claims: Loss and Damage Filing Deadlines
meta_description: How freight loss and damage claims work: the three things a claim must contain, the carrier's 30-day and 120-day duties, and the statutory minimum filing and suit periods.
